basics.name: resourceGroupName
basics.label: Resource group name
basics.toolTip: Name of the resource group to create.

constraints.validationMessage: 1-90 characters: letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '(' and ')'. Cannot end with a period.

elements.name: virtualNetworkName
elements.label: Virtual network name
elements.toolTip: Name of the virtual network to create.

constraints.validationMessage: 2-64 characters: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. Must start with a letter or digit and end with a letter, digit or '_'.

elements.name: addressSpace
elements.label: Address space
elements.toolTip: IPv4 CIDR block for the virtual network. A /22 or larger is required to accommodate all subnets.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /22.

elements.name: clusterIngressEndpointType
elements.label: Cluster ingress endpoint type
elements.toolTip: Public: external gateway on a public IP. Private: internal gateway.

elements.name: enableAzureFirewall
elements.label: Enable Azure Firewall for egress control
elements.toolTip: Forces all egress through an Azure Firewall.

elements.name: enableFrontDoor
elements.label: Enable Azure Front Door
elements.toolTip: Front Door is created downstream of this deployment; only the request is recorded.

elements.name: availabilityZones
elements.label: AKS cluster availability zones
elements.toolTip: Availability zones used by the AKS cluster and its node pools. Zonal networking resources in this template (public IPs, Azure Firewall) always span zones 1, 2 and 3 and are not affected by this selection.
